questions.question:
Three of the following numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: (First number × 3) × First number = Second number

Option 1) 11 – 363

__(11 × 3)__ × 11 = 363

__33 × 11__ = 363

363 = 363 (LHS = RHS)

Option 2) 13 – 507

__(13 × 3)__ × 13 = 507

__39 × 13__ = 507

507 = 507 (LHS = RHS)

Option 3) 15 – 450

__(15 × 3)__ × 15 = 450

__45 × 15__ = 450

**675 ≠ 450 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Option 4) 9 – 243

__(9 × 3)__ × 9 = 243

__27 × 9__ = 243

243 = 243 (LHS = RHS)

Thus, out of all the options '15 – 450' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
